prompt: Build an editable executive-readout PPTX from the approved synthetic content fixture and its reviewed storyboard.
expected_outcome: The output deck contains all source section titles and selected source statements as native editable text.
The deck has the declared storyboard slide count and covers every source section.
The deck passes native-shape, font, palette, classification, source-notes, and packaged-image validation.
must_not: Scrape or depend on a microsite DOM.
Pass a raster-only deck or a deck with missing source content.

prompt: Reject a generated deck when required native text, approved font, palette, source notes, dimensions, or packaged images are corrupted.
expected_outcome: Each deliberately corrupted PPTX is rejected with a specific validation error.
must_not: Accept a structurally valid ZIP package that violates the deck contract.
